Advertisement for the post of Digital Media Designer (Graphic Designer/Video
Editor/Interior Designer/Animator/)
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research
Project entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project”. Posts is purely on contract basis
and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post: Digital Media Designer (Graphic Designer/Video Editor/Interior Designer/Animator/)
Qualification:
Essential: Diploma or Degree in Graphic Designing / Animation / Interior Designer /Mass
Communication / Applied Arts / Allied discipline.
Desirable:
Having applicable working experience in Script/Content Writing (Hindi/English), Adobe Premiere
Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe after Effect, Adobe InDesign,, interior design,
and related software, AI Generative Tools like Runway ML, Envato Elements, Sora, short format
content creation, social media analytics, camera handling and related softwares
• Candidate should provide at least 1 recommendation letter and work experience in same field.
a) Salary: Rs. 31000/- per month (fixed)
b) Job Description:
• A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having good knowledge
of Graphic Design Skills, brainstorming creative designing ideas, Good interpersonal skills,
Ability to Work in Strict Deadlines, Researching and preparing rough drafts.
• Should be able to manage social media account for wider reach of IEC material.
• Able to understand brief provided and create high quality visual within given timelines
• Candidate should be available for immediate joining, if selected
Hardcopy of Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work
experience etc should reach to the undersigned latest by 3 January 2026 before 2.00 pm in room
no 227, Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh. The application
form can be downloaded from Panjab University jobs website link
(https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php). Application via email will also be considered.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/ArWqH6P6WN3jE2i59 before
submitting application with document in the office The interview date and time will be informed
through email to shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules
and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency will govern the selected
candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator E. Mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
